data.one_liner: Brazilian ZIP code (CEP) lookup via ViaCEP, BrasilAPI and OpenCEP with offline validation and cache.
data.what_it_does: Queries Brazilian postal codes (CEPs) using multiple providers with fallback mechanisms. It also supports address-to-CEP searches, coordinate retrieval, and offline format/range validation.
use_when: Building forms that need to auto-complete addresses based on Brazilian CEPs.
Looking up latitude and longitude for a given Brazilian ZIP code.
Validating and formatting CEP strings offline.
avoid_when: You need global postal code lookups outside of Brazil.
strengths: Supports multiple fallback providers (ViaCEP, BrasilAPI, OpenCEP).
Includes offline helpers for validation and state detection.
Built-in in-memory caching and request timeout handling.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to Brazilian postal codes.
Relies on public third-party APIs which may experience downtime or rate limits.
